raw_text: Has anyone verified this video going around from Srinagar? It shows a massive crackdown with pellet guns and what looks like live rounds being fired. The casualties shown are pretty graphic. Some users are saying this is happening today but the resolution and the vehicles in the video look older to me. Can someone confirm? The building in the background at 0:34 might help geolocate this.
clean_text: Reddit user questioning viral Srinagar crackdown video. Notes video resolution and vehicles look older. Asks for verification and geolocation help using building visible at 0:34 timestamp.
